fills.researcher_notes: CONTINGENT FILL -- read the contingency before pasting. The SSE 2023 bond prospectus states a single design pressure for the Jiangxi Phase I network's trunk lines: '一期工程 ... 干线全长 860 公里（不含支线）... 管道设计压力为 6.3 兆帕'. That is a uniform engineering design parameter for the 干线 class (unlike a length or a cost, it does not divide across segments), and the 2014 DRC plan names 高安-新余 as one of those six built 干线 -- so the two documents together do reach this segment. Corroborated independently by the 2024-12-31 江西省能源局 approval, which specifies 6.3 MPa for the section of the new interconnection that ties into the PHASE I network ('第二段 ... 设计压力6.3兆帕') versus 10 MPa for the WEP2 side ('第一段 ... 设计压力10兆帕') -- i.e. 6.3 MPa is the Phase I network's operating grade at exactly this location (高安市大城镇). THE CONTINGENCY: this value is correct only under the Phase I reading of the row, which is what the __REDUNDANCY__ and __VALIDITY__ records establish. Under the sheet's own current label ('West-East Gas Pipeline 2') the answer would be 10.0 MPa -- every Jiangxi West-East asset in PipeChina's 2026 facility workbook is 10.0 MPa. So DO NOT paste 6.3 while the row still claims to be a WEP2 branch: the pressure decision and the identity decision are one decision. If P5861 is retired into P4778 (recommended), 6.3 MPa belongs on P4778, whose Pressure cell is blank. Held at tier low and independent=false because no source states a pressure for 高安-新余 by name -- the value comes from a class-level statement plus a naming source.
